title: IPC admin.endpoints.set_enabled params
description:
Disabling an endpoint revokes its live lease at once (`endpoint.lease_changed`) and never auto-rebinds; the change is kept in the state directory's endpoint overlay, written before it is published and before it is answered, so it survives a restart; config.yaml is never written (ADR-0028 A 2026-10-11).

2.0.0 (ADR-0067 decision 7, IPC major 3): every EndpointId here is the derived id of `endpoints/endpoint-id` 2.0.0 -- the 52-character name of the endpoint's Ed25519 key -- and a label of the grammar ADR-0067 retired is refused; no reader of the earlier major tolerates the value, so the shape takes a major.
